items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to a hip injury; McVay notes he is not making great progress and the team is being cautious (not long-term/hernia).
items.why: Consecutive DNPs + coach comments on limited progress and caution
items.implication: Davante Adams elevated as primary WR; high target share expected
items.opportunity: Adams 142 routes/42% target rate without Nacua historically; strong production in prior absences

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day with a hamstring injury.
items.why: Back-to-back DNPs after missing Week 2 (Grade 1 strain)
items.implication: Continued absence boosts TE Dalton Schultz target share
items.opportunity: Schultz saw 30% route targets / 28% team target share last week without Collins; faces Colts allowing high TE yards

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) had good MRI results, is practicing suited up, and expects to play Monday vs Bears.
items.implication: Clears major uncertainty for Eagles backfield; reverse any handcuff ramps

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers missed practice for the second straight day (hamstring); looking likely to miss a second consecutive game amid Brazil travel.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs; aggravated Aug 20 injury after strong Week 1 half
items.implication: Ravens WR depth strained; monitor for secondary options
items.opportunity: Hasn't practiced full since aggravation; travel complicates recovery

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after knee surgery; ACL intact but season-ending, full recovery expected.
items.implication: Giants seek QB options (Flacco rumors denied); impacts NYG pass catchers long-term

items.text: TNF questions: Has Marshawn Lloyd ceded GB backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Can healthy Penix revive Drake London/Kyle Pitts? Reed absence more 2-TE? OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.implication: Monitor snaps for London/Pitts boost with Penix; Watson upside if Reed out; Lloyd downgrade risk
items.opportunity: Penix-London historical 20+ PPR/35% tgt/97 yds; Reed OUT favors 2TE/Watson

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Henderson led NE snaps/touches post-Stevenson fumble (still ranks Stevenson ahead); London 20+ PPR/35% tgt/97 yds with Penix; Schultz high tgts sans Collins; Brooks IR locks Hubbard lead.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet; London boost with Penix; Hubbard secure; Schultz startable
items.opportunity: Henderson 65% snaps after fumble; London historical with Penix; Hubbard RB1 clear
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson despite usage shift

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Strong production in Nacua absences (e.g. 8-195-2).
items.why: Historical route/target data when Nacua off field
items.implication: Adams WR1 lock if Nacua sits Week 3
items.opportunity: 42% target rate + proven big games; primary beneficiary of Nacua OUT

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert (MCL sprain) expected to miss multiple weeks, will avoid IR; DNP Thursday. Zach Ertz signed to PS.
items.why: MCL sprain confirmed by Rapoport/Schefter; multi-week timeline
items.implication: Eagles TE thin (Stowers/Calcaterra already IR); limited fantasy upside for backups
items.opportunity: Mundt/Jenkins/Ertz in line but low pass volume historically

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks to IR after core-muscle surgery; out at least 6 weeks. Chuba Hubbard locked as lead back.
items.implication: Hubbard clear RB1/volume leader for extended stretch; Dillon backup
items.opportunity: Hubbard high snap/utilization already; RB2+ upside next 6+ weeks

items.text: Berry loves Brock Purdy (vs ARI smash spot high total/bad secondary), Patrick Mahomes (@MIA soft pass D), Derrick Henry (vs DAL Brazil high prop/soft rush D), Chase Brown (@PIT volume + matchup).
items.implication: Strong start signals for these in Week 3
items.opportunity: Henry highest rush prop; Brown 20+ touches/15% tgt both games; Purdy high team total

items.text: Berry loves Chris Olave (vs LV high aDOT/air yards soft WR D), Parker Washington (vs NE 36% tgt share deep), Christian Watson (vs ATL high util/RZ), Dalton Schultz (@IND high tgt sans Collins + TE D).
items.why: Target share, aDOT, matchup, absence-driven usage
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% tgt share last week; Olave double-digit tgts both weeks; Watson WR8 util

items.text: Berry hates Baker Mayfield (vs MIN tough pass D), Travis Etienne (low snaps/touches even with Kamara), Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX post-fumble low volume tough run D), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA elite WR D low total), Rome Odunze (vs PHI low tgt hard coverage).
items.why: Poor matchups, low recent usage/snaps, team totals
items.opportunity: Henderson saw 65% snaps/out-touched Stevenson post-fumble; Etienne only 49% touches/38% 3rd down
